agent.title: Account assistant
agent.noAccount: Connect an Instagram account in Settings to begin.
agent.pauseWarning: Pausing stops new assistant work. Already submitted or uncertain actions keep their outcome tracking; a pause cannot undo them.
agent.connectionRequired: Reconnect the account before enabling or resuming work.
agent.migrationWarning: Changing control cancels unsubmitted work and starts a new ownership period. Existing uncertain operations continue to be reconciled. Delegation stays separate: enabling does not grant permission.
agent.ownerOnly: Only the workspace owner can change permissions or account control.
agent.managerOnly: Owners and managers can edit voice and goals.
agent.capabilityHint: Availability comes from the connected provider and current grants. Permission settings cannot enable an unavailable capability.
agent.goalsHint: Goals guide the assistant; they do not grant permissions or replace verified business facts.
agent.reloadWarning: Your edits are kept here. Loading the latest saved settings discards these edits so you can review and try again.
agent.reloadCurrent: Discard edits and load current settings
agent.previewDisclosure: Local illustrative sample using your example or tone. It does not run a model, use business facts, or send a message. No model cost.
agent.sample_warm: Assistant: Of course! What would you like to know?
agent.sample_neutral: Assistant: What information do you need?
agent.sample_direct: Assistant: Tell me what you need help with.
agent.delegationHint: Set each action separately. Asking creates an explicit action approval; a business answer never approves an action. Limits and request sources apply to that action only.
agent.changeWarning: Applying invalidates unsubmitted authorizations. Review the exact changes before applying.
agent.taskHint: Ask for work on this account. Preparing content does not approve scheduling or publication. Only your own requests appear here.
agent.outcomeHint: Only a verified successful operation is complete. Queued and unknown outcomes are still pending.

intro.overview: Direct your assistant, follow its work and see what it can do on this account.
intro.voice: How the assistant sounds in messages and comments. Goals guide it; they never grant permissions.
intro.permissions: Decide, action by action, what the assistant may do on its own, what it must ask about, and what it never does.
intro.history: Every loaded request and recorded action, by day. Filter by what they need from you.

sentence.active: Ready for new work, within the permissions you set.
sentence.paused: Paused. No new work starts until you resume.
sentence.inactive: Not running. It starts no work on this account.
sentence.legacy: The account assistant is not in control. Your previous automation settings apply.

counts.note: Work counts cover conversations, comments and requests on this account; completed and failed are all-time totals.

composer.placeholder: Describe what you need, for example a post for this weekend…

blocked.connection: Reconnect the Instagram account to send new requests.
blocked.legacy: Enable the account assistant to send requests.
blocked.paused: Resume the assistant to send new requests.
blocked.inactive: The assistant is not active, so it cannot take requests.

suggestions.post: Prepare a feed post introducing our services
suggestions.story: Prepare a story for this weekend
suggestions.faq: Prepare a post answering a question customers often ask

recorded.title: Recorded and queued
recorded.body: Your request appears under Your requests with its status.

works.title: The assistant works on it
works.body: It may ask you for information it does not have.

control.title: You stay in control
control.body: Actions set to ask for approval wait for you in Approvals.

requests.empty: No requests yet. Ask above; each request and its progress appears here.
requests.more: Showing {{shown}} of {{count}} recent requests. Open History for the rest.

capability.none: The connection reports no capabilities yet.
capability.conflict: Allowed, but the connection does not provide it.
capability.editPermissions: Edit what the assistant may do

problem.needs_reauth: Google needs you to sign in again before the assistant can use this calendar.
problem.degraded: The calendar is responding unreliably; bookings may be delayed.

control.title: Control
control.legacyHint: Hands the account back to the previous topic automation. Use only if you need the earlier behaviour.

history.noMatch: Nothing in this filter right now.
history.requestsMeta: Only your own requests appear here.

empty.title: Your assistant needs an Instagram account

agent.voiceIntro: Shape how replies read. Facts such as prices and hours always come from your verified business information.

voiceSections.examplesHint: Up to two short lines per language that sound like your business.

voiceSummary.title: Voice at a glance
voiceSummary.hint: Updates as you choose; saved only when you save.

permissions.needsCapability: This Instagram connection does not provide this capability.

legend.ask: It prepares the action; you approve it in Approvals.
legend.automatic: It acts without asking, within limits and request sources.
